messages:
Camille: Heads-up: starting perf bring-up for aurora-15b int4 candidate in staging. Goal: baseline throughput/latency for a client-like mixed workload and a context sweep to 32k. Kicking off now.

Priya: Nice. What's the run list? batch sizes, seq lens?

Camille: Run plan: quick probe -> steady-state throughput runs. Batch sizes [1,2,4,8,16,32], tokens per request 512 and 2048. Context sweep: 2k, 8k, 16k, 32k. Also test KV cache behavior, cold starts, and quantized vs float perf delta.

Nate: I can provision a 3-GPU ded pool for the runs. Any kernel preference: nvfuser or cutlass?

Sasha: We should capture p95/p99/p99.9 latencies and tail token latencies, plus token/sec. Also GPU memory, util, and per-GPU load. I'll add trace sampling for p95 outliers.

Camille: Config snippet to copy:
```json
{
  "model": "aurora-15b",
  "precision": "int4",
  "batch_sizes": [1,2,4,8,16,32],
  "seq_lens": [512,2048],
  "ctx_sweep": [2048,8192,16384,32768],
  "kernels": ["cutlass","nvfuser"]
}
```

Priya: I'll add a quick quality smoke: 200 prompts from the regression suite at each quant/float point to catch big generation regressions before full perf runs.

benchbot: auto: started run aurora-15b int4 probe 1769991234. artifacts: s3://redwood-eval/aurora15b/1769991234/probe.log

Nate: Provisioned ded-pool-aurora-3g. Node ids: g-3-12, g-3-13, g-3-14. Autoscale disabled.

Camille: Cold start test: 3 sequential cold requests, recording 1st-token latency. Warmup: 100 requests batch=16.

Sasha: Note: for ctx > 16k KV cache and attention memory may change kernel selection. Add a kernel-fallback check: if OOM on cutlass, retry with nvfuser and log the switch.

Priya: I'll run the regression eval after the probe and post quick accuracy/delta plots. If we see >2% drop on core QA metrics we pause and tag for quality triage.

benchbot: probe summary: mean token/sec 45, p95 latency 120ms (batch=1, seq=512). full logs uploaded: s3://redwood-eval/aurora15b/1769991234/probe-summary.json

Camille: Looks reasonable. Next up: full throughput sweep. ETA ~90m. Flagging eng-oncall if any node flakiness shows.

Nate: I'll tail system metrics. If GPU mem >95% or temp >83C I'll kill the job and capture diagnostics.

Sasha: Reminder: when posting results include the helm/deploy config and the random seed used for reproducibility.

Camille: Short checklist I'll attach to the PR: 1) probe ok 2) regression smoke ok 3) throughput sweep ok 4) ctx >16k stability verified 5) kernel fallbacks logged 6) perf profile attached 7) recommendation: onboard / needs quant-tuning.

Priya: If we onboard, recommend starting with a canary route limited to 10 qps and automatic fallback to float16 on quality regressions.

benchbot: run complete: throughput sweep finished. artifacts: s3://redwood-eval/aurora15b/1769991234/full-sweep-1769991234.tar.gz. summary: peak tok/s 3200 (batch=32, ctx=2048), p99 token latency 2.8s at ctx=32k batch=8.

Camille: Awesome — opening a PR with artifacts and a short triage doc. tagging @Sasha @Nate @Priya for review. :rocket:
